title: IDMS must protect against the use web services that do not require a sign on when actions are performed that may be audited.
check_content:
On the IDMS CV system where CA IDMS Web Services executes, enter "WEBC" to check Web Services configuration.

If "REQUIRE SIGNON = NO", this is a finding.
fixtext: On the IDMS CV system where CA IDMS Web Services executes, enter "WEBC REQUIRE SIGNON=YES".
VulnDiscussion: IDMS web services provide a way for web-based applications to access an IDMS database. If not secured, the Web services interface could be used to reveal or change sensitive data.
